hook.text: You know 22 players by name. How many of Allah’s names?

verses.text: “Do not despair of the mercy of Allah.”

end.text: You know 22 players by name. How many of Allah’s names?
end.gold: Tonight after Maghrib: learn one name of Allah. Just one.

captions: Saturday, 10:40 p.m. The bus stop. Your voice is gone.
Ninety minutes singing his name. Every word by heart.
Earlier. Minute 78. He steps up for the penalty.
He misses. And 40,000 voices turn on him.
One mistake, and they forget everything he gave.
You think of your own mistakes. Who would still take you back?
Sunday night, walking to Isha. A new name on your lips.
Al-Ghafur. The One who forgives. Again, and again.

post.caption:
You know 22 players by name. How many of Allah’s names? ⚽

Minute 78. He misses the penalty — and 40,000 voices turn on him. One mistake, and they forget everything he gave. Who would still take you back after yours?

“Do not despair of the mercy of Allah.” (39:53)

Tonight after Maghrib: learn one name of Allah. Start with Al-Ghafur — the One who forgives.
